preconditions: Fresh read-only gates confirm exact staging host, installed tree digest, active SANRO Studio/WooCommerce, private storage, and no access to production.
Fresh read-only check confirms installer journal is committed, lock is free, and current feature flags are OFF before the session.
Exactly one identified synthetic design, cart line, and WooCommerce order; no customer or existing order is eligible.
Staging sandbox gateway is configured to prevent external settlement; if absent, stop before checkout/order creation.
Google OAuth identity is verified for the staging-only target folder; no customer or production Drive folder may be used.
A tested rollback/disable procedure is ready; after the session all three writers return to OFF and readback proves OFF.
integrated_sequence: Capture authenticated admin screenshot and verify exactly one independent top-level SANRO Studio menu outside WooCommerce.
Re-read candidate/runtime identity, private storage and all writer flags.
Submit the already verified synthetic front/back design and server quote to classic WooCommerce checkout.
Create at most one pending synthetic order; verify locked DesignID, size quantities, server price, shipping/tax/discount guards, and admin WooCommerce detail panel.
Use only the staging sandbox gateway, then verify same-order retry/payment-complete idempotency and that no second order is created.
Generate private DTF candidate assets from that order; verify provenance, dimensions, hashes and human-approval gate; do not release to physical production.
Provision/upload the same order package to the verified staging Drive folder; verify remote identity/permissions and idempotent recovery without public sharing.
Capture sanitized evidence, verify order/artifact binding and all writer flags OFF after the session.
stop_conditions: Any hash, host, installed digest, source marker, menu count, private-storage boundary or feature flag differs from the exact approved values.
Any live payment gateway, external settlement, production host/path, customer order, unbounded order creation, or Drive target mismatch is detected.
Any non-synthetic item, unapproved tax/fee/coupon behavior, stale quote, missing provenance, unsafe artifact permission, or writer recovery failure occurs.
